routine: 복습 3분(영어 가리고 먼저 쓰기) → 가리고 써 보기 2분(빈칸 먼저, 맨 끝 정답 확인) → 새 내용 5분(노트에 옮길 때 짝 표현째로) → 소리 내어 3번 읽기 3분 → 오늘 쓸 표현 1개 골라 실제 메일에 쓰기

review.title: 복습 (10/28·10/26 표현 + 오답, 영어로 먼저 써 보기)

items.answer: I didn't mean ~. What I need is ~.

items.prompt: (필요성·금액의) 타당한 이유를 대다 — explain why we need 대신

items.answer: This represents an increase of ~% compared with ~.

items.prompt: 아직 처리·제출되지 않은 — not yet received 대신

cover_practice.prompt: 불일치: Please explain the d__________ between the TB and the asset list.
지켜보다: Please m______ the yellow SSDs every month.
먼저 하다: Please p_________ the urgent shipments this week.
해결하다: Has the POM system issue been r_______?
알리다: Please a_____ us of the new loading time.

words.example: Could you explain the 5-pcs discrepancy between the test qty and the box sheet?
words.collocations: a discrepancy between A and B / explain the discrepancy

words.meaning: (계속) 지켜보다, 점검하다 — check again every month 대신
words.example: Please monitor the 8 SSDs at 51-70% every month.

words.meaning: 우선 처리하다, 먼저 하다 — do first 대신
words.example: Please prioritize D001 and D059 because they show "Bad".
words.collocations: prioritize A over B / prioritize safety

words.example: Please let me know once the broken stitch issue is resolved.
words.collocations: resolve an issue / be resolved by [시간]

words.example: Please advise us of the flight and the airport cut-off time.
words.collocations: advise A of B / please advise

patterns.pattern: Please keep me posted on ~ until ~.
patterns.meaning: ~까지 ~ 진행 상황을 계속 알려 주세요 (share the status every week 대신)
patterns.email: Please keep me posted on the IRC status until it is issued.

patterns.pattern: When will you be able to ~?
patterns.meaning: 언제 ~해 주실 수 있을까요? (When will ~ finish? 대신, 부드럽게 일정 묻기)
patterns.skeleton: When will you be able to + [동사원형]
patterns.email: When will you be able to send the final pass/fail qty?
patterns.spoken: When can you get it done?

patterns.pattern: If ~ is not ~ by ~, we will have to ~.
patterns.meaning: ~까지 ~되지 않으면 ~할 수밖에 없습니다 (결과·대안을 미리 알릴 때, maybe we need to 대신)
patterns.skeleton: If + [주어] + is not + [p.p.] + by [시간], we will have to + [동사]
patterns.email: If the boxes are not fixed by noon, we will have to change the flight.
patterns.spoken: If not, we'll have to move it.

rewrite.original: The test qty is 181 pcs, but the box sheet shows 186 pcs for [PO]. What is the 5 pcs difference?
rewrite.improved: The test qty is 181 pcs, but the box sheet shows 186 pcs for [PO]. Could you explain the 5-pcs discrepancy?
rewrite.note: What is the difference? → Could you explain the discrepancy?: 숫자가 안 맞을 때 업무 메일에서 쓰는 표준 단어가 discrepancy다. 질문을 Could you explain ~?으로 바꾸면 '설명해 달라'는 요청이 분명해지고 따지는 느낌이 줄어든다. 5 pcs가 명사 앞에서 꾸밀 때는 5-pcs처럼 하이픈을 붙인다.

source: 10/28 보낸 메일(SO 634-2610-0018 지연 위험·Trinh·Lency·Sateesh, IT 자산 SSD 교체·Quan, 감가상각 수정·Nga, 환경허가·An·Trinh), 받은 메일(Elena 'When will you be able to advise us of ~', Vanie 'We will keep you posted', Vince Nesrine 'if it won't be resolved overnight, I will have to ~', Quan 'monitor')
